 The Ministry of Health has requested Shopee and Lazada to stop selling Dáng Sen food products.
 The Food Safety Department of the Ministry of Health has requested Shopee and Lazada to stop selling and remove information about Dáng Sen food products because the products have not yet been granted a registration certificate.
 Báo Lào Cai • 12/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 On November 12th, the Food Safety Department ( Ministry of Health ) issued six official documents regarding the handling of advertising and sales information for the Dáng Sen food product. Through post-inspection, the Department discovered that this product was being advertised and sold on Facebook, Shopee, and Lazada without having received a Certificate of Product Registration. On Shopee and Lazada, the product was advertised as having weight-loss benefits.
 Both exchanges must report by November 20th. 
 Accordingly, the Food Safety Department requested Shopee Vietnam Co., Ltd. and Lazada Vietnam E-commerce Co., Ltd. to immediately cease business operations, remove information about Dang Sen food products, and submit a written report to the Department before November 20, 2026. 
 The Food Safety Department of the Ministry of Health has requested Shopee and Lazada to stop selling and remove information about Dáng Sen food products because the products have not been granted a registration certificate (Photo: Provided by the Food Safety Department). You may also like The Department also requested the two businesses to urgently review their functional food business activities on the platform, and only sell products that have been granted a Certificate of Acceptance of Product Declaration Registration or have been published on the Food Safety Data Information System as prescribed.
 At the same time, the Food Safety Department requested the Department of E-commerce and Digital Economy (Ministry of Industry and Trade) to continue notifying Shopee, Lazada, and the stores on these two platforms, requesting them to cease business, remove information about the products, and handle the matter according to the law .
 The Food Safety Department also requested the Department of Broadcasting, Television and Electronic Information (Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism) to remove information about the Dáng Sen product from Facebook and handle any violations according to regulations.
 We request that Hung Yen and Hanoi inspect the production and distribution facilities. 
 Dáng Sen food products are manufactured by Thai Hung Import-Export Trading Investment Joint Stock Company, located in Ben Hiep village, Minh Tho commune, Hung Yen province. The products are distributed by Nam Y Duong Co., Ltd., located at 13H1 Tran Kim Xuyen Street, Yen Hoa Ward, Hanoi.
 You may also like The Food Safety Department requested the Hung Yen Provincial Food Safety and Hygiene Sub-Department to urgently verify and inspect the production, business, and advertising activities of Dang Sen food products at Thai Hung Company. In Hanoi, the Department requested the Hanoi City Food Safety and Hygiene Sub-Department to verify and inspect the business and advertising activities of products at Nam Y Duong Company.
 The Department requests that the two localities take strict action if violations are detected and send the results to the Department before November 30, 2026.
